sql: SELECT p.name AS property, ROUND(SUM(b.total_usd), 2) AS revenue_usd FROM bookings AS b JOIN properties AS p ON p.id = b.property_id WHERE b.property_id = 'mountain-lodge' AND b.status <> 'cancelled' AND b.check_in BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY p.name LIMIT 500
answer: Mountain Lodge's total revenue in September 2026 was $201,145.
message: Sums non-cancelled booking revenue at Mountain Lodge for check-ins in September 2026.
